label: D1 update-gate dip after a1 led rarely to S2, scaled by a1 preference
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * isin(prev_state,[1]) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action==1) * (prev_state==2) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * choice ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state==2) * choice
explanation: Raw update gate z43 sits near 1 (mean 0.987); GO and D2 barely vary. Its magnitude is set at D1 by the previous trial: after a1 led rarely to S2, z drops a lot (about -0.17 if unrewarded, -0.10 if rewarded, relative to timing). The drop is deeper when the trial before was also a1 -> S2, and it grows later in the episode. After the previous trial reached S1, z is slightly higher (+0.02). Other histories (a2 trials, a1 S1) give little change. Within a1 -> S2 histories, the D1 dip scales with the model policy logit at D1 (a stronger a1 preference means lower z); a main D1 policy term adds a little more. Two prev-trial indicators alone give dev R^2 0.61 beyond timing; adding the a1 S2 repeat, the S1 term and the ep_trial slope (observed cues only) gives 0.66 dev; adding the D1 policy-logit terms (model output, not future) gives 0.76 dev / 0.753 test, above the additive all ceiling of 0.74. No future variables used. Remaining misses: D1 dips on the first trial of a window, where the previous trial is unknown.

issues: Minor: the dip comes from the interaction of the a1->S2 indicator with the D1 policy logit, not from the indicator alone. The fitted weight on last_is('a1 S2 u') is +0.163 and the weight on (prev a1->S2)*choice is -0.045. 'Scaled by a1 preference' is accurate, but the policy logit is a model output, so the explanation is partly in terms of the network's own output. Without the logit terms, observed-only terms reach 0.652 on test, against an all-observed ceiling of 0.70.

Checked each claim on test. The two a1->S2 indicators alone give 0.594. Adding the two-in-a-row a1->S2 term gives 0.602 (+0.007), the slope over episode trial 0.609 (+0.015), the prev-state S1 term 0.630 (+0.036), and the logit terms 0.674. All have the claimed effect, but the two-in-a-row and episode-trial effects are small.

The residual tables match the stated numbers: at D1, a1 S2 u -0.165 and a1 S2 r -0.098; after S1 about +0.02; a2 histories +0.006 to +0.028. At GO, and at D2 apart from small effects after a1 histories (down to -0.01 after a1 S2 u), magnitudes stay within about 0.01.

Misses: mean error by phase is at most 0.005. The worst (phase, previous trial) cells are D1 after a2 S1 u (-0.022 over-predicted) and D1 after a2 S2 r / a1 S1 r (+0.009). The largest single misses are deep D1 dips (around 0.65 vs 0.93 predicted) on a window's first trial, where the previous trial is unknown. The D1 policy logit does not predict these either: adding (prev unknown)*max(choice,0) leaves test R^2 at 0.753.
A few dips after a2 S2 trials appear in the misses (e.g. 0.74 after a2 S2 common unrewarded). Adding an a2->S2 x policy-logit term only reaches 0.757 on test, so this is not a large systematic class.
Reported test R^2 of 0.7526 reproduced exactly. It is above the additive ceiling of 0.74. No future variables are used.
